releases.notes:
**_Hi! This is the first ever version of this mod I post online._**
_I hope people will enjoy it even if there isn't much for now. However, I already have a few features planned for the future! For example, I want to add a table saw (that will work like the stonecutter) and more shields._
# Current features:
## Items
### Tree Bark
- Obtained by stripping logs
- Each log drops between 1 and 2
- Can be used as fuel
- Can be composted
### Wooden Armor
- Crafted by following the regular armor patterns with tree bark
- Can be used as fuel
- Wooden Helmet: armor 1 / durability 22
- Wooden Chestplate: armor 1 / durability 32
- Wooden Leggings: armor 1 / durability 30
- Wooden Boots: armor 1 / durability 26
